response.note: GMV is computed as the sum of amount_inr over successful orders created in September 2026; the 'SUCCESS' value for order_status is an assumption and may need adjusting if the data uses a different label.
response.sql: SELECT SUM(amount_inr) AS gmv_inr FROM v_orders WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' AND order_status = 'SUCCESS' LIMIT 50
